verdict.rationale: Sierra's Insights and Explorer products provide dashboards/reports with drill-down and natural-language trend analysis (sierra-docs-10, sierra-docs-11, sierra-docs-12, sierra-docs-13), showing the platform surfaces analytics for support leaders, but no evidence specifies the exact metrics named in the story (resolution rate, CSAT, handoff rate, cost per resolution). Missing for 10: explicit documentation naming these specific KPIs, screenshots/examples of the actual dashboard metrics, and independent confirmation that leaders use it for exec-level reporting.
